
[5/9] Claude Code · 5-hour limit

  Does your Claude Code subscription have a 5-hour usage limit?
  Asked once for each selected app. No means only the weekly limit is guarded.
  yes/no

>
[6/9] Claude Code · Guarded limits

  Choose the limits to guard for Claude Code.
  An unguarded limit never blocks work, even when it is exhausted or unmeasured.
    1. 5-hour limit only
    2. Weekly limit only
    3. Both, each with its own threshold (current)
  Enter to keep/select: Both, each with its own threshold
